title: KestrelCare Benefits Schedule Note: Trip Day Limit on Major Repairs
content:
**Note to the trip interruption column of the KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts benefits schedule.** The trip days are capped as follows: where the claim payments on the repair order total at least the major-repair payment of 2000.00 USD and the repair is on the engine or the transmission, the cap is the plan's maximum days plus the major-repair extra days (2); where they total at least the extended-repair payment of 1000.00 USD and the first case does not apply, the cap is the plan's maximum days plus the extended-repair extra day (1); otherwise the cap is the plan's maximum days.

The claim payments are all claim payment entries posted on the repair order of the plan's most recent approved decision; the vehicle system is the one on that decision.

| Claim payments on the repair order | Engine or transmission repair | Trip day cap |
|---|---|---|
| 2000.00 or more | yes | maximum days plus 2 |
| 2000.00 or more | no | maximum days plus 1 |
| 1000.00 to 1999.99 | any | maximum days plus 1 |
| below 1000.00 | any | maximum days |

*Hypothetical plan with a maximum of 3 days:* payments of 2350.00 on an engine repair give a cap of 5 days; the same payments on a suspension repair give 4; payments of 640.00 give 3.
